name: Flutter
postCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y unzip xz-utils && git clone https://github.com/flutter/flutter.git -b stable --depth 1 $HOME/flutter && echo 'export PATH="$HOME/flutter/bin:$PATH"' >> $HOME/.bashrc && $HOME/flutter/bin/flutter config --enable-web && $HOME/flutter/bin/flutter precache --web
